physical.title: shirt
physical.summary: A man's shirt, which comes just above the knee.  Made of undyed cream-coloured tabby woven cotton cloth; commercially produced.  A straight panel, both front and back, with six additional panels and two very small diamond-shaped gussets, create an A-line shape; machine stitched.  The 'V' shaped neck opening has an additional embroidered flap inside, secured, unseen, with a popper.  A vertical panel of geometric embroidery decorates the flap, using mainly yellow, but also pink and lilac cotton threads.  Framed by drawn thread work.  The embroidery on the small round collar is entirely different: denser geometric embroidery in isolated colours: red, green and dark brown.  The collar is secured with a beige plastic button and loop.  The sleeves, which are at right angles to the body of the shirt, are each made of three pieces of fabric.  Delicate embroidery at the end of the sleeve, an 'X' motif alternating with a six-petalled flower motif, work in white silk (?), and pink, yellow, lilac and green cotton threads.  The hem is turned and machine stitched.
